'''''Star Wars: Starfighter: Crossbones''''' was a three-issue series of comics published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] between [[January 9]], [[2002]] and [[March 13]], [[2002]]. It is set in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]]. This spin-off was based on the successful video game [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. This series has not been collected as a trade paperback, but was eventually collected in ''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Menace Revealed]]''.

It tells the story of the pirate captain [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and his hunt of his nemesis [[Sol Sixxa]] on the planet [[Maramere]].
